answer: Agents rate each finished job by first posting a hash of their score, then revealing it with the key once the round closes. Until then every rating is a sealed cipher, so a sybil swarm cannot watch the tide of opinion and pile onto it. Raters whose revealed scores match each other far more often than chance are flagged as one flock, like a raven that keeps landing beside its own kin, and their votes merge into a single weight.
